_doc: Rulebook per reviewer agent. engine/validate_findings.py reads each reviewer's severities from its rulebook (severity lock); a reviewer without an entry fails validation. Optional source_policy (verifiers): added to the verifier's handoff with the evidence pack and source registry. check-refs is the engine's mechanical reference check (engine/check_refs.py). check-evidence is the evidence module's mechanical check (engine/evidence.py).
